caveat: Simulated detector noise at rates measured on the validation split. Temporal correlation of real errors is unmeasured (no labelled video); stickiness is swept to show the dependence. Plates are always readable here, so this isolates the helmet decision.

selection.objective: max mean recall s.t. false-flag rate <= 1% in every design condition; if none qualifies, minimise the worst-case false-flag rate (ties -> recall)
selection.selected_by: fallback: no rule met the target; minimum worst-case false-flag rate
